card.name: Capitalized opening word of a new sentence
card.fires_on: A capitalized sentence-starting word, most often "Complete", right after a period or a section reference like ( 2.1 ). It also fires on words such as Modify, Strong and adult at the start of a dosing or monitoring statement.

modes.label: Complete as a sentence opener
modes.description: The word Complete begins an instruction or heading right after a period or a bracketed section number.
modes.example: ( 2.1 )<< Complete>> the infusion approximately 30 minutes prior

modes.label: Other opening words in dosing text
modes.description: Words like Modify, Strong or adult start a clause in dosing tables or highlights.
modes.example: more than or equal to 5 but less than 10 × ULN<< Modify>> dosage to 135 mcg

card.plain: It marks the first word of a new instruction in a drug label, especially the word Complete.
